title: Change the image of the Kadokawa intro and the menu texts

posts.author: malwux
posts.body:
Hello everyone, I'm new to RPG Maker 2000/2003 (I accept answers from both 2000 and 2003)
Does anyone know how to change the image of Kadokawa that appears in the intro? (I would like to put a personalized one) several say that it is impossible but I know a game that could change that image but I can't understand how it did it
and I also want to know how to change the menu texts (not the font, just the text) I see that they say that it is changed in Terms of Database System but that option does not appear
Thanks for reading me.

posts.author: malwux
posts.body:
Hello, thanks for answering but I have questions
1- to replace the screen, should I convert my image into an XYZ?  or how exactly do I replace it?  I found the logo file in resource hacker, it is an XYZ that I don't know how to replace it with my logo
2-I don't see that terms option in the database, could it be that I have an old version?

posts.author: DevRPG2k
posts.body:
To convert an image to XYZ you can import the PNG image into Pictures in a new project and then export it as XYZ. Remember that the image must be 8-Bit.
Where did you download this RPG Maker?
